capabilities: open a daily note by typing a natural-language date
add a daily-note command to the command palette
build on Natural Language Dates date parsing
extras: Install steps look copy-pasted from another plugin: they tell users to search for "Line Commands". README also covers release/build steps for developers rather than usage.
intentEvidence: Requires "Natural Language Dates" plugin to work.
motivation: The author needed a faster way to open a daily note, e.g. to recall something or add to a future daily note.
problem: Opening a specific daily note requires using a calendar or remembering the exact file name.

relations.evidence: It requires the Natural Language Dates plugin to be enabled.

summary: Command plugin that opens a daily note by typing a natural-language date, built on the Natural Language Dates plugin.
